run_greeter_client: run the gRPC Hello World client that calls SayHello without using protoc code generation
create_grpc_protos: create a dynamic proto message schema by parsing a .proto file with grpc.protos
create_grpc_services: create a dynamic service schema by parsing a .proto file with grpc.services
call_say_hello: call the Greeter.SayHello RPC method using dynamically loaded proto and service schemas
review_grpc_no_codegen: review the no-codegen gRPC client example that parses .proto files at runtime
